crossRefs.note: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the…
The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will…
The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
“Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house…
Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words, and does them, I will show you who he is like.

translations.web: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
translations.bsb: He leans on his web, but it gives way; he holds fast, but it does not endure.
translations.kjv: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
translations.asv: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: He shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.
